preconditions.description: Number of gnomes is between 1 and 500.
Number of queries is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 10**9 for k, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query time k is between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for k, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query gnome id x is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= g[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the friendship matrix g is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: There are exactly 2 lines of output for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[2*i] == str(len(receivers)) for i, (k, x) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: The first line of each pair corresponds to the number of gnomes who know the joke after k minutes.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[2*i+1] == ' '.join(map(str, sorted(receivers))) or output_lines[2*i+1] == '-1' for i, (k, x) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: The second line of each pair lists the ids of gnomes who know the joke in increasing order, or '-1' if no one knows the joke.
